index.title: Monitor and Organize Incoming Messages
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Inbox Triage. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Monitor and Organize Incoming Messages. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a diff
index.what_happened_excerpt: This person created a public Grok Bot prompt for inbox triage, connecting multiple tools to automate message organization and filtering. The job is now available for public use, following the published prompt.
